<!-- eCommHarvest — registration step, block 1 of 2: ABOVE the form
     SELF-CONTAINED: includes the stylesheet, so no GHL CSS field is involved.
     Paste into a "Custom JS/HTML" element placed ABOVE your form element.
     Block 2 goes below the form and does not repeat the stylesheet.
-->
<style>
/* eCommHarvest — GoHighLevel stylesheet, inlined
 *
 * This lives inside the block, so nothing needs pasting into any GHL CSS field.
 *
 * Every selector is namespaced 'ech-' and scoped under '.ech-scope', so this
 * cannot restyle GoHighLevel's own buttons, forms or text — and GHL's styles
 * cannot leak into these blocks.
 *
 * Generated by ghl/build.mjs. Edit the source, not this file.
 */

/* --- scoped reset: keeps the host page's global CSS out of these blocks --- */
.ech-scope *,
.ech-scope *::before,
.ech-scope *::after{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;outline:0!important;background:transparent!important;
  font:inherit!important;font-size:inherit!important;font-weight:inherit!important;font-family:inherit!important;font-style:normal!important;
  line-height:inherit!important;letter-spacing:inherit!important;text-transform:none!important;text-decoration:none!important;
  text-align:inherit!important;color:inherit!important;list-style:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;float:none!important;
  vertical-align:baseline!important;text-indent:0!important;white-space:normal!important;box-sizing:border-box!important}
.ech-scope strong,.ech-scope b{font-weight:700!important}
.ech-scope em,.ech-scope i{font-style:italic!important}
.ech-scope img,.ech-scope iframe{max-width:100%!important;border:0!important}
.ech-scope button{cursor:pointer!important;-webkit-appearance:none!important;appearance:none!important}
/* --- end scoped reset --- */
.ech-scope{
  --white:#FFFFFF;
  --navy:#16324F;        /* Ink Navy */
  --navy-deep:#0F2439!important;
  --gold:#C99132;        /* Wheat Gold */
  --gold-deep:#8B6423!important;   /* Deep Gold */
  --brown:#45331B!important;       /* Harvest Brown */
  --cream:#F2ECE0!important;       /* Linen Cream */
  --chalk:#A9BECF!important;       /* Chalk Blue */

  --wash:#F5F0E6!important;
  --wash2:#FBF8F3;
  --ink:#16324F;
  --muted:#4E627A;
  --line:#DCE5EC;
  --line-2:#EBF0F4;

  --font:"Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
  --maxw:920px;
  --r:26px;
  --r-sm:16px;
}.ech-scope *{box-sizing:border-box!important}.ech-scope{scroll-behavior:smooth!important}.ech-scope{margin:0!important;background:var(--white)!important;color:var(--ink)!important;font-family:var(--font)!important;font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.6!important;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased!important}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ech-scope{scroll-behavior:auto!important}.ech-scope *{transition:none!important}}.ech-scope a{color:inherit!important}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-deep)!important;outline-offset:3px!important;border-radius:4px!important}

/* ---- top bar ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-topbar{position:sticky!important;top:0!important;z-index:60!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)!important}.ech-scope .ech-topbar-in{max-width:var(--maxw)!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:16px 32px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-brand{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;text-decoration:none!important}/* Height comes from Site Styles via --logo-h; 41px — the "Medium" value — is
   the default if it is unset,  so the header looks right before anyone touches
   that screen. */
.ech-scope .ech-brand img{height:var(--logo-h,41px)!important;width:auto!important;display:block!important}.ech-scope .ech-topbar-right{margin-left:auto!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:12px!important}.ech-scope .ech-stamp{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:10.5px!important;letter-spacing:.07em!important;color:var(--muted)!important;white-space:nowrap!important}

/* ---- site menu ---- */
/* Inline on a desktop; behind a button on a phone. One list of links in the
   markup either way — the CSS decides which presentation is showing,  so there is
   never a second copy to keep in step. */
.ech-scope .ech-topnav{margin-left:auto!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:26px!important}.ech-scope .ech-navlink{font-size:14.5px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:-.012em!important;color:var(--navy)!important;text-decoration:none!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent!important;padding-bottom:2px!important;transition:border-color .15s ease,color .15s ease!important;white-space:nowrap!important}.ech-scope .ech-navlink:hover{border-color:var(--gold)!important}/* The emphasised link is a real button,  because "book a thing" should not look
   like "read about a thing". */
.ech-scope .ech-navlink-cta{background:var(--gold)!important;color:#0F2439!important;border:none!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:10px 20px!important;
  font-weight:800!important;font-size:13.5px!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;letter-spacing:.02em!important}.ech-scope .ech-navlink-cta:hover{background:#B67F26!important;border-color:transparent!important}.ech-scope .ech-navtoggle{display:none!important;background:none!important;border:0!important;padding:10px!important;margin:0!important;cursor:pointer!important;border-radius:10px!important}.ech-scope .ech-navtoggle:hover{background:var(--wash2)!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars{display:block!important;width:22px!important;height:14px!important;position:relative!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars span{position:absolute!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;height:2px!important;background:var(--navy)!important;border-radius:2px!important;transition:transform .18s ease,opacity .18s ease!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars span:nth-child(1){top:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars span:nth-child(2){top:6px!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars span:nth-child(3){top:12px!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars-open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6px) rotate(45deg)!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars-open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-navbars-open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg)!important}.ech-scope .ech-navpanel{display:none!important}

/* ---- the builder on a phone ---- */
/* There used to be a notice here saying the builder needed a bigger screen. This
   replaces it: the same editor, laid out for a thumb.

   The problem being solved is Puck's grid. It puts the block list and the field
   editor in columns either side of the canvas, so on a 390px screen the page
   being edited gets 204px and everything is unusable. Below 900px those panels
   are lifted out of the grid and laid over the canvas instead, one at a time, full width — with our own bars above and below for the things that would
   otherwise be behind an unlabelled icon.

   Puck's class names are content-hashed, so its own elements are matched on the

   rather than trusting the CSS. */
.ech-scope .ech-editor-topbar, .ech-scope .ech-editor-actionbar, .ech-scope .ech-editor-sheet, .ech-scope .ech-editor-blockbar{display:none!important}/* While the editor's JavaScript loads. Every screen size: it is a lot of code, 
   and a white page for two seconds reads as a broken link. */
.ech-scope .ech-editor-loading{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
  gap:6px!important;height:100dvh!important;text-align:center!important;padding:24px!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-loading p{margin:0!important;color:var(--muted)!important}

@media(max-width:900px){/* --editor-bottom is replaced with the bar's measured height as soon as the
     editor mounts (see MobileShell.ech-tsx); this is the value used for the first
     paint,  and the fallback if that ever fails. */
  .ech-scope{--editor-top:46px;--editor-bottom:calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}/* Puck's own header carries the page name and two icon toggles. Both bars
     below replace it,  and 67px of a phone screen is better spent on the page. */
  .ech-scope .ech-Puck [class^="_PuckHeader_"]{display:none!important}/* Room for our bars, so nothing scrolls the whole document — and the full
     width for the canvas, whatever Puck's grid says. (Descendant selectors,  not
     child: the drag-and-drop provider puts an unclassed div in between.) */
  .ech-scope .ech-Puck [class^="_PuckLayout-inner_"]{
    height:calc(100dvh - var(--editor-top) - var(--editor-bottom))!important;
    grid-template-columns:0 100% 0!important}/* And a panel, when open,  covers it rather than squeezing it. */
  .ech-scope .ech-Puck [class^="_Sidebar_"]{position:fixed!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;
    top:var(--editor-top)!important;bottom:var(--editor-bottom)!important;width:auto!important;z-index:60!important;
    background:var(--white)!important;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(15,36,57,.22)!important}.ech-scope .ech-Puck [class^="_Sidebar-resizeHandle_"]{display:none!important}/* iOS zooms the page when a field smaller than 16px takes focus,  and never
     zooms back out. Applies to the editor's own inputs; the canvas has none. */
  .ech-scope .ech-Puck input, .ech-scope .ech-Puck textarea, .ech-scope .ech-Puck select{font-size:16px!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-topbar{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:10px!important;height:var(--editor-top)!important;
    padding:0 12px!important;background:var(--white)!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-back{font-family:var(--font)!important;font-weight:700!important;font-size:13px!important;color:var(--navy)!important;
    text-decoration:none!important;white-space:nowrap!important;padding:8px 4px!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-pagename{flex:1!important;min-width:0!important;font-size:13px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;
    overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;white-space:nowrap!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-icon{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;flex:none!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:10px!important;
    background:var(--white)!important;color:var(--navy)!important;font-size:17px!important;line-height:1!important;cursor:pointer!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-icon:disabled{opacity:.35!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-actionbar{display:block!important;position:fixed!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;z-index:70!important;
    background:var(--white)!important;border-top:1px solid var(--line)!important;
    padding:0 10px env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)!important;box-shadow:0 -8px 24px rgba(15,36,57,.10)!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-status{margin:0!important;padding:4px 2px 0!important;font-size:11.5px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;text-align:center!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-status-bad{color:#B4241C!important;font-weight:700!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-actionrow{display:flex!important;gap:8px!important;padding:6px 0 10px!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-btn{flex:1!important;min-height:44px!important;font-family:var(--font)!important;font-weight:700!important;font-size:14px!important;

    box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(15,36,57,.22)!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-sheet-head{padding:14px 16px 10px!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-sheet-head h2{margin:0!important;font-size:18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-sheet-head p{margin:4px 0 0!important;font-size:12.5px!important;color:var(--muted)!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-sheet-body{flex:1!important;overflow-y:auto!important;padding:10px 12px 20px!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-sheet-group{margin:14px 4px 6px!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.10em!important;
    text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-blockrow{display:block!important;width:100%!important;text-align:left!important;min-height:48px!important;
    font-family:var(--font)!important;font-weight:600!important;font-size:15px!important;color:var(--navy)!important;
    background:var(--white)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:12px!important;
    padding:13px 14px!important;margin-bottom:8px!important;cursor:pointer!important}/* Move and delete,  above the fields of the selected block. */
  .ech-scope .ech-editor-blockbar{display:flex!important;gap:8px!important;padding:10px 12px!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important;
    background:var(--wash2)!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-btn-small{min-height:40px!important;font-size:13px!important}.ech-scope .ech-editor-btn-danger{color:#B4241C!important}
}

/* ---- consent bar ---- */
/* Bottom of the screen, above everything, and it does not cover the page's own

   about measurement is a good way to lose the registration you were measuring. */
.ech-scope .ech-consentbar{position:fixed!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;z-index:90!important;background:var(--white)!important;

  padding:18px 22px!important;display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;align-items:center!important;gap:14px 22px!important;justify-content:center!important}.ech-scope .ech-consentbar p{margin:0!important;font-size:14.5px!important;line-height:1.5!important;color:var(--brown)!important;max-width:70ch!important}.ech-scope .ech-consentbar a{color:var(--gold-deep)!important}.ech-scope .ech-consentbar-actions{display:flex!important;gap:10px!important;flex:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-consentbar .ech-btn{font-size:13.5px!important;padding:11px 22px!important}.ech-scope .ech-btn-ghost{background:transparent!important;color:var(--navy)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important}.ech-scope .ech-btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--wash2)!important;color:var(--navy)!important}

/* ---- buttons ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-btn{display:inline-block!important;font-family:var(--font)!important;font-weight:700!important;font-size:16px!important;
  background:var(--gold)!important;color:#0F2439!important;border:none!important;padding:14px 28px!important;border-radius:999px!important;
  text-decoration:none!important;cursor:pointer!important;letter-spacing:.02em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;
  transition:background .15s ease,transform .15s ease!important}.ech-scope .ech-btn:hover{background:#B67F26!important;transform:translateY(-1px)!important}.ech-scope .ech-btn-lg{padding:19px 40px!important;font-size:17px!important}

/* ---- layout ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-slot{background:var(--white)!important}.ech-scope .ech-slot.ech-hero{background:linear-gradient(178deg,#FAF6EE 0%,#FDFBF7 46%,var(--white) 100%)!important;position:relative!important}.ech-scope .ech-slot.ech-hero::after{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;height:1px!important;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--line),transparent)!important}.ech-scope .ech-slot.ech-wash{background:var(--wash2)!important}.ech-scope .ech-slot-in{max-width:var(--maxw)!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:72px 32px!important}.ech-scope .ech-slot.ech-hero .ech-slot-in{padding-top:64px!important}

/* ---- type ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-eyebrow{font-size:12.5px!important;font-weight:800!important;letter-spacing:.13em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important;margin:0 0 18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-badge{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:9px!important;background:var(--cream)!important;color:var(--brown)!important;
  font-size:12.5px!important;font-weight:800!important;letter-spacing:.11em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;
  padding:9px 18px!important;border-radius:999px!important;margin:0 0 26px!important}.ech-scope .ech-badge::before{content:""!important;width:7px!important;height:7px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:var(--gold)!important;flex:none!important}.ech-scope h1{font-weight:800!important;font-size:clamp(36px,4.9vw,56px)!important;line-height:1.04!important;letter-spacing:-.042em!important;margin:0 0 24px!important;max-width:17ch!important}.ech-scope h2{font-weight:800!important;font-size:clamp(27px,3.3vw,38px)!important;line-height:1.1!important;letter-spacing:-.035em!important;margin:0 0 20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-lede{font-size:19.5px!important;line-height:1.55!important;letter-spacing:-.012em!important;color:var(--muted)!important;max-width:62ch!important;margin:0 0 32px!important}.ech-scope p{margin:0 0 20px!important;max-width:66ch!important;color:var(--brown)!important}.ech-scope .ech-leadin{font-size:18px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:-.018em!important;color:var(--ink)!important;margin:0 0 10px!important;max-width:60ch!important}.ech-scope .ech-plus{font-size:16.5px!important;color:var(--brown)!important;margin:26px 0 0!important;padding:18px 22px!important;background:var(--cream)!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;max-width:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-plus strong{color:var(--navy)!important}

/* ---- cta ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-cta-row{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;align-items:center!important;gap:20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-cta-row-2{margin-top:36px!important}.ech-scope .ech-cta-micro{font-size:14.5px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;line-height:1.45!important}

/* ---- bullets ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-bullets{list-style:none!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-bullets li{display:flex!important;gap:14px!important;padding:17px 0!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)!important;font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.5!important;color:var(--brown)!important}.ech-scope .ech-bullets li:last-child{border-bottom:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-bullets li::before{content:""!important;width:8px!important;height:8px!important;border-radius:2px!important;background:var(--gold)!important;flex:none!important;margin-top:9px!important}.ech-scope .ech-bullets .ech-b-t{flex:1 1 auto!important;min-width:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-bullets strong{color:var(--navy)!important;font-weight:700!important}

/* ---- cards ---- */
.ech-scope h3{font-weight:800!important;font-size:20px!important;line-height:1.28!important;letter-spacing:-.022em!important;margin:0 0 10px!important}/* The masterclass page only ever needed three columns. The page builder lets a

   would silently render as one stacked column. */
.ech-scope .ech-cols-2, .ech-scope .ech-cols-3, .ech-scope .ech-cols-4{display:grid!important;gap:20px!important;margin-top:34px!important}.ech-scope .ech-cols-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)!important}.ech-scope .ech-cols-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)!important}.ech-scope .ech-cols-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)!important}.ech-scope .ech-cols-1{display:grid!important;gap:20px!important;margin-top:34px!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.ech-scope .ech-card{background:var(--wash)!important;border:1px solid var(--line-2)!important;border-radius:var(--r)!important;padding:32px!important}.ech-scope .ech-card p{margin:0!important;font-size:15.5px!important;color:var(--muted)!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark{background:linear-gradient(163deg,#183551 0%,var(--navy) 50%,#102439 100%)!important;color:var(--cream)!important;border-radius:var(--r)!important;padding:44px!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark h2{color:var(--cream)!important;margin-bottom:22px!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark p{color:#D6E0E8!important;max-width:64ch!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark p:last-child{margin-bottom:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark .ech-eyebrow{color:var(--gold)!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark strong{color:var(--white)!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark em{color:var(--chalk)!important;font-style:italic!important}.ech-scope .ech-formula{font-weight:800!important;font-size:clamp(19px,2.5vw,27px)!important;letter-spacing:-.035em!important;line-height:1.25!important;margin:0 0 26px!important;color:var(--cream)!important;max-width:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-formula .ech-x{color:var(--gold)!important;padding:0 6px!important}

/* ---- final cta ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-final-in{max-width:var(--maxw)!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:20px 32px 88px!important}.ech-scope .ech-finalcard{background:linear-gradient(168deg,#183551 0%,var(--navy) 52%,#0E2135 100%)!important;color:var(--cream)!important;border-radius:34px!important;padding:70px 48px!important;text-align:center!important;position:relative!important;overflow:hidden!important}.ech-scope .ech-finalcard::before{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;top:0!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;height:5px!important;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold) 0%,#D9B45E 42%,var(--chalk) 100%)!important}.ech-scope .ech-finalcard h2{color:var(--cream)!important;max-width:20ch!important;margin:0 auto 30px!important;font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,34px)!important}.ech-scope .ech-finalcard .ech-eyebrow{color:var(--gold)!important}.ech-scope footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)!important;background:var(--white)!important}.ech-scope .ech-foot-in{max-width:var(--maxw)!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:34px 32px!important;display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;gap:16px!important;justify-content:space-between!important;font-size:13.5px!important;color:var(--muted)!important}

/* ---- hero deck (subhead) ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-deck{font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,24px)!important;font-weight:600!important;color:var(--navy)!important;line-height:1.34!important;letter-spacing:-.022em!important;margin:0 0 20px!important;max-width:27ch!important}

/* ---- hosted-by bar ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-hostbar{background:var(--wash2)!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important}.ech-scope .ech-hostbar-in{max-width:var(--maxw)!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:34px 32px!important;text-align:center!important}.ech-scope .ech-host-label{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.16em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0 0 20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-hosts{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:22px 52px!important}.ech-scope .ech-host{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:12px!important;text-decoration:none!important;transition:opacity .15s ease!important}.ech-scope .ech-host:hover{opacity:.72!important}.ech-scope .ech-host-name{font-size:14.5px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:var(--navy)!important;letter-spacing:-.018em!important;white-space:nowrap!important}/* A partner's own logo, at their own proportions.
 *
 * This used to squeeze every logo into a 44px navy circle beside the brand name
 * set in our typeface. Almost every brand's logo is a lockup — symbol *and*
 * wordmark, in their own colour — so that arrangement cropped the thing they
 * care most about, recoloured what was left, and then repeated the name they had
 * just been denied the chance to show.
 *
 * A box, not a size. Both caps apply and `object-fit: contain` fits the logo
 * inside them, so a long wordmark is limited by the width and a square symbol by
 * the height. Different shapes then carry roughly the same optical weight in the
 * row,  which is what makes a set of mismatched logos read as deliberate — and it
 * needs nothing from the person adding them.
 */
.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo{flex:none!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
  height:var(--host-h,46px)!important;max-width:var(--host-w,210px)!important}.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo img{max-height:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;object-fit:contain!important;display:block!important}
/* For the one logo that still reads too light or too heavy beside the others. */
.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-small{--host-h:34px;--host-w:150px}.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-large{--host-h:62px;--host-w:270px}/* A card, for a logo that cannot sit on the bar as it is: a white or reversed
   logo would be invisible,  and a logo with its own white background shows a hard
   edge against the cream. */
.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-card{padding:10px 16px!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;background:var(--white)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important}.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-dark{padding:10px 16px!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;background:var(--navy)!important;border:1px solid var(--navy)!important}/* No logo yet: initials,  which is better than an empty gap and honest about
   being a placeholder. */
.ech-scope .ech-host-mark{flex:none!important;width:44px!important;height:44px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:var(--cream)!important;border:1px solid #E6DBC6!important;
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
  font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:11.5px!important;font-weight:500!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important}

/* ---- when / logistics line ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-when{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:13px!important;letter-spacing:.01em!important;color:var(--brown)!important;background:var(--cream)!important;
  display:inline-block!important;padding:10px 18px!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;margin:0 0 26px!important;max-width:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-when strong{font-weight:500!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important}.ech-scope .ech-when-tz{opacity:.7!important}

/* ---- formula bar (navy strip) ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-fbar{background:linear-gradient(168deg,#183551 0%,var(--navy) 60%,#0E2135 100%)!important;border-radius:var(--r)!important;
  padding:36px 40px!important;margin:30px 0 8px!important;text-align:center!important}.ech-scope .ech-fbar .ech-formula{margin:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-closer{font-weight:700!important;font-size:17.5px!important;color:var(--navy)!important;letter-spacing:-.02em!important;margin:34px 0 0!important}.ech-scope .ech-fbar-note{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:11.5px!important;letter-spacing:.09em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--chalk)!important;margin:16px 0 0!important}

/* ---- speakers ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-speakers{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;gap:22px!important;margin-top:32px!important}.ech-scope .ech-speaker{background:var(--wash)!important;border:1px solid var(--line-2)!important;border-radius:var(--r)!important;padding:32px!important}.ech-scope .ech-sp-tag{display:inline-block!important;font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:10.5px!important;letter-spacing:.11em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;
  color:var(--brown)!important;background:var(--cream)!important;padding:5px 12px!important;border-radius:999px!important;margin:0 0 18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-sp-top{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:16px!important;margin:0 0 18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-sp-photo{flex:none!important;width:68px!important;height:68px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:var(--cream)!important;border:1px solid #E6DBC6!important;
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:16px!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important}.ech-scope .ech-sp-photo img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;border-radius:50%!important;object-fit:cover!important;display:block!important}.ech-scope .ech-sp-name{font-size:21px!important;font-weight:800!important;letter-spacing:-.03em!important;line-height:1.14!important;margin:0 0 4px!important}.ech-scope .ech-sp-role{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.08em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important;margin:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-speaker p{margin:0 0 12px!important;font-size:16px!important}.ech-scope .ech-speaker p:last-child{margin:0!important}

@media(max-width:760px){.ech-scope{font-size:16px!important}.ech-scope{--r:20px}/* The logo goes to the middle on phones.
     Three columns rather than flex centring, because the logo has to be centred
     in the *bar*, not in the space left over beside the menu button — those are
     different positions, and the second one looks like a mistake. The outer
     columns match whether or not a button is in the left one, which is what
     `has-nav` is for: no menu, no reserved space,  still centred. */
  .ech-scope .ech-topbar-in{padding:12px 14px!important;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr!important;gap:8px!important}.ech-scope .ech-topbar-in .ech-brand{grid-column:2!important;grid-row:1!important;justify-content:center!important}.ech-scope .ech-topbar-in.ech-has-nav .ech-navtoggle{grid-column:1!important;grid-row:1!important;justify-self:start!important;display:block!important}.ech-scope .ech-topnav{display:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-legalhead, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock{padding-left:20px!important;padding-right:20px!important}/* Capped at Medium, not scaled: an "extra large" logo chosen on a desktop
     must not eat a phone screen,  but a small one should stay small. */
  .ech-scope .ech-brand img{height:min(var(--logo-h,41px),41px)!important}/* The panel is positioned, so opening the menu cannot reflow the page behind
     it. `.ech-topbar` is sticky,  which makes it the containing block. */
  .ech-scope .ech-navpanel{position:absolute!important;top:100%!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;background:var(--white)!important;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(22,50,79,.08)!important;
    display:none!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:stretch!important;padding:8px 14px 16px!important}.ech-scope .ech-navpanel-open{display:flex!important}.ech-scope .ech-navpanel .ech-navlink{padding:15px 4px!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)!important;font-size:16.5px!important}.ech-scope .ech-navpanel .ech-navlink:last-child{border-bottom:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-navpanel .ech-navlink-cta{margin-top:12px!important;text-align:center!important;padding:15px 20px!important;border-bottom:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-slot-in{padding:52px 20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-lede{font-size:18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-card-dark{padding:30px 24px!important}.ech-scope .ech-final-in{padding:12px 20px 60px!important}.ech-scope .ech-finalcard{padding:48px 24px!important;border-radius:24px!important}.ech-scope .ech-foot-in{padding:28px 20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-btn-lg{padding:17px 30px!important;font-size:16px!important}.ech-scope .ech-topbar-right{display:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-cols-1, .ech-scope .ech-cols-2, .ech-scope .ech-cols-3, .ech-scope .ech-cols-4{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:14px!important;margin-top:26px!important}.ech-scope .ech-card{padding:26px 22px!important}.ech-scope .ech-hostbar-in{padding:26px 20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-hosts{gap:20px 30px!important}/* Logos shrink on a phone rather than wrapping to one per line, which would
     turn a partner bar into a scroll. The caps stay proportional to each other, 
     so the row keeps the balance it has on a laptop. */
  .ech-scope .ech-hostlogo{--host-h:36px;--host-w:150px}.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-small{--host-h:28px;--host-w:112px}.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-large{--host-h:46px;--host-w:190px}.ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-card, .ech-scope .ech-hostlogo-dark{padding:8px 12px!important}.ech-scope .ech-speakers{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:14px!important}.ech-scope .ech-speaker{padding:26px 22px!important}.ech-scope .ech-fbar{padding:28px 22px!important;border-radius:20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-deck{max-width:none!important}
}

/* ---- registration form ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-formcard{max-width:520px!important;margin:0 auto!important;text-align:left!important}.ech-scope .ech-field{margin:0 0 16px!important}.ech-scope .ech-field label{display:block!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.02em!important;color:var(--cream)!important;margin:0 0 7px!important}.ech-scope .ech-field .ech-opt{font-weight:500!important;color:var(--chalk)!important;letter-spacing:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-field input[type=text], .ech-scope .ech-field input[type=email], .ech-scope .ech-field input[type=url]{
  width:100%!important;font-family:var(--font)!important;font-size:16px!important;color:var(--ink)!important;background:var(--white)!important;
  border:1px solid transparent!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;padding:14px 16px!important;-webkit-appearance:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px!important}.ech-scope .ech-field input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:#E0894E!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(224,137,78,.22)!important}.ech-scope .ech-err{display:block!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#F2B37A!important;margin:7px 0 0!important}.ech-scope .ech-consent{display:flex!important;align-items:flex-start!important;gap:11px!important;margin:0 0 22px!important;text-align:left!important}.ech-scope .ech-consent input{flex:none!important;width:19px!important;height:19px!important;margin:2px 0 0!important;accent-color:var(--gold)!important;cursor:pointer!important}.ech-scope .ech-consent label{font-size:13.5px!important;line-height:1.45!important;color:var(--chalk)!important;font-weight:400!important;letter-spacing:0!important;margin:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-consent a{color:var(--cream)!important;text-decoration:underline!important;text-underline-offset:2px!important}.ech-scope .ech-formcard .ech-btn{width:100%!important}.ech-scope .ech-formcard .ech-btn[disabled]{opacity:.6!important;cursor:progress!important}/* max-width:none because the base `p{max-width:66ch!important}` resolves against the mono
   font here and caps the line at ~437px,  which centres the text inside a
   left-hugging box rather than under the button. */
.ech-scope .ech-formnote{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.06em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--chalk)!important;text-align:center!important;max-width:none!important;margin:16px 0 0!important}.ech-scope .ech-formerr{background:rgba(224,137,78,.15)!important;border:1px solid rgba(242,179,122,.4)!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;
  padding:13px 16px!important;font-size:14.5px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#F7C99B!important;margin:0 0 18px!important;max-width:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-hp{position:absolute!important;left:-9999px!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;overflow:hidden!important}

/* ---- site footer nav ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-foot-nav{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;gap:18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-foot-nav a{color:var(--muted)!important;text-decoration:none!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important}.ech-scope .ech-foot-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)!important;border-color:var(--gold)!important}

/* ---- legal / content pages ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-legal{max-width:760px!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:64px 32px 88px!important}/* The same document typography, whether the page is hand-built (.ech-legal wraps
   the whole thing) or assembled in the page builder (each block carries
   .ech-legalhead or .ech-legalblock). Identical output either way,  which matters
   because /privacy falls back to the hand-built version if the builder page is
   ever missing — the two must not look like different sites. */
.ech-scope .ech-legalhead, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock{max-width:760px!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:0 32px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legalhead{padding-top:64px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legalblock:last-child{padding-bottom:88px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal h1, .ech-scope .ech-legalhead h1{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,42px)!important;max-width:24ch!important;margin:0 0 10px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal .ech-updated, .ech-scope .ech-legalhead .ech-updated{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:12px!important;letter-spacing:.07em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0 0 40px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal h2, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock h2{font-size:clamp(20px,2.3vw,25px)!important;margin:44px 0 14px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal h3, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock h3{font-size:17px!important;margin:28px 0 8px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal p, .ech-scope .ech-legal li, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock p, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock li{font-size:16.5px!important;line-height:1.65!important;color:var(--brown)!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal ul, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock ul{padding-left:22px!important;margin:0 0 20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal li, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock li{margin:0 0 9px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal a, .ech-scope .ech-legalblock a{color:var(--gold-deep)!important;text-underline-offset:2px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal .ech-callout{background:var(--cream)!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;padding:20px 24px!important;margin:0 0 34px!important}.ech-scope .ech-legal .ech-callout p{margin:0!important;font-size:15.5px!important}.ech-scope .ech-backlink{display:inline-block!important;font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:12px!important;letter-spacing:.07em!important;
  text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important;text-decoration:none!important;margin:0 0 32px!important}.ech-scope .ech-backlink:hover{text-decoration:underline!important}

/* ---- the blog ---- */
/* Cards on the index. Auto-fit rather than a fixed column count,  so one post
   does not sit alone in a three-column grid and five do not need a breakpoint
   written for them. */
.ech-scope .ech-postcards{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr))!important;gap:26px!important;margin-top:8px!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard{background:var(--white)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;overflow:hidden!important;
  transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(22,50,79,.09)!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard-link{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;height:100%!important;text-decoration:none!important;color:inherit!important}/* A fixed 16:9 window, so a row of cards lines up whatever shape the covers
   are. The image fills it and is cropped from the centre — a cover is
   decoration,  and a consistent grid is worth more than showing all of one. */
.ech-scope .ech-postcard-cover{display:block!important;aspect-ratio:16/9!important;background:var(--wash2)!important;overflow:hidden!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard-cover img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover!important;display:block!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard-body{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;gap:8px!important;padding:22px 24px 26px!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard-title{font-size:20px!important;line-height:1.28!important;letter-spacing:-.02em!important;margin:0!important;color:var(--navy)!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard-excerpt{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.6!important;color:var(--muted)!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcard:hover .ech-postcard-title{color:var(--gold-deep)!important}/* One article. The same measure and the same type as the legal pages — a site
   should have one way of setting a page of prose,  not one per section. */
.ech-scope .ech-article{max-width:760px!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:8px 32px 0!important}.ech-scope .ech-article h1{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,44px)!important;max-width:24ch!important;margin:0 0 12px!important}.ech-scope .ech-article-meta{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:12px!important;letter-spacing:.06em!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0 0 26px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlecover{margin:0 0 34px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlecover img{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;display:block!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody p, .ech-scope .ech-articlebody li{font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.7!important;color:var(--brown)!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody h2{font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,27px)!important;margin:44px 0 14px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody h3{font-size:18px!important;margin:30px 0 8px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody p{margin:0 0 20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody ul, .ech-scope .ech-articlebody ol{padding-left:22px!important;margin:0 0 22px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody li{margin:0 0 9px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody a{color:var(--gold-deep)!important;text-underline-offset:2px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody strong{color:var(--navy)!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody blockquote{margin:0 0 24px!important;padding:4px 0 4px 20px!important;border-left:3px solid var(--gold)!important;
  color:var(--navy)!important;font-size:18px!important;line-height:1.6!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody blockquote p{margin:0!important;color:inherit!important;font-size:inherit!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody code{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:.92em!important;background:var(--cream)!important;padding:2px 6px!important;border-radius:6px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody hr{border:none!important;border-top:1px solid var(--line)!important;margin:36px 0!important}.ech-scope .ech-articleimage{margin:0 0 26px!important}.ech-scope .ech-articleimage img{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;border-radius:var(--r-sm)!important;display:block!important}.ech-scope .ech-articleimage figcaption{font-size:13px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin-top:8px!important}

/* ---- thank you ---- */
.ech-scope .ech-thanks{max-width:var(--maxw)!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:80px 32px 96px!important;text-align:center!important}.ech-scope .ech-tick{width:64px!important;height:64px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:var(--cream)!important;color:var(--gold-deep)!important;
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;margin:0 auto 26px!important;font-size:30px!important;font-weight:800!important}.ech-scope .ech-thanks h1{max-width:26ch!important;margin:0 auto 18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-thanks .ech-lede{margin:0 auto 34px!important;text-align:center!important}.ech-scope .ech-addcal{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;gap:12px!important;justify-content:center!important;margin:0 0 40px!important}.ech-scope .ech-btn-ghost{background:transparent!important;color:var(--navy)!important;border:1.5px solid var(--line)!important;text-transform:none!important;letter-spacing:0!important;font-size:15px!important}.ech-scope .ech-btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--wash2)!important;border-color:var(--gold)!important;transform:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-nextsteps{text-align:left!important;max-width:620px!important;margin:0 auto!important}

@media(max-width:760px){.ech-scope .ech-legal{padding:44px 20px 64px!important}.ech-scope .ech-article{padding:4px 20px 0!important}.ech-scope .ech-articlebody p, .ech-scope .ech-articlebody li{font-size:16.5px!important}.ech-scope .ech-postcards{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:18px!important}.ech-scope .ech-thanks{padding:56px 20px 72px!important}.ech-scope .ech-addcal .ech-btn{width:100%!important}
}

/* ============================================================
   Member area (/learn) and auth pages
   ============================================================ */

.ech-scope .ech-appbar{position:sticky!important;top:0!important;z-index:60!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)!important}.ech-scope .ech-appbar-in{max-width:1120px!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:14px 32px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:20px!important}.ech-scope .ech-appbar-nav{margin-left:auto!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:20px!important;font-size:14.5px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:-.012em!important}.ech-scope .ech-appbar-nav a{color:var(--muted)!important;text-decoration:none!important}.ech-scope .ech-appbar-nav a:hover, .ech-scope .ech-appbar-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--ink)!important}.ech-scope .ech-signout{background:none!important;border:none!important;font:inherit!important;color:var(--muted)!important;cursor:pointer!important;padding:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-signout:hover{color:var(--ink)!important}.ech-scope .ech-shell{max-width:1120px!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:48px 32px 88px!important}.ech-scope .ech-shell-narrow{max-width:760px!important}.ech-scope .ech-pagehead{margin:0 0 34px!important}.ech-scope .ech-pagehead h1{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px)!important;max-width:24ch!important;margin:0 0 10px!important}.ech-scope .ech-pagehead p{margin:0!important;color:var(--muted)!important;font-size:17px!important}

/* course cards */
.ech-scope .ech-courses{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr))!important;gap:22px!important}.ech-scope .ech-coursecard{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;background:var(--wash2)!important;border:1px solid var(--line-2)!important;
  border-radius:var(--r)!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-decoration:none!important;transition:border-color .15s ease,transform .15s ease!important}.ech-scope .ech-coursecard:hover{border-color:var(--gold)!important;transform:translateY(-2px)!important}.ech-scope .ech-coursecard-body{padding:26px!important}.ech-scope .ech-coursecard h2{font-size:21px!important;margin:0 0 8px!important;letter-spacing:-.028em!important}.ech-scope .ech-coursecard p{font-size:15px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0!important}.ech-scope .ech-coursecard-foot{margin-top:auto!important;padding:16px 26px!important;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)!important;
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:10px!important;font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:11px!important;
  letter-spacing:.08em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--muted)!important}.ech-scope .ech-lockpill{background:var(--cream)!important;color:var(--brown)!important;padding:4px 10px!important;border-radius:999px!important;font-weight:500!important}.ech-scope .ech-lockpill.ech-is-open{background:#E8F0E4!important;color:#3D5C33!important}

/* progress bar */
.ech-scope .ech-bar{height:6px!important;background:var(--line-2)!important;border-radius:999px!important;overflow:hidden!important}.ech-scope .ech-bar span{display:block!important;height:100%!important;background:var(--gold)!important;border-radius:999px!important;transition:width .3s ease!important}.ech-scope .ech-bar-label{font-family:var(--mono)!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.07em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:8px 0 0!important}

/* curriculum */
